newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SOCCER-UJPEST LEFT TO REGRET MISSED CHANCES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UJPEST LEFT TO REGRET MISSED CHANCES.

text.p: Hungarian side Ujpest were held to a goaless draw in Budapest against Danish opponents Aarhus, but had enough second half chances to have given themselves a comfortable lead for the second-leg.
After a dismal first-half with neither side creating any opportunities, Hungarian international Zoltan Kovacs had two clear chances to score as Ujpest searched for a goal in the second period.
On the hour, Kovacs flatfooted the Danish defense with an outstanding turn but then shot wide from ten yards with only keeper Lars Winfeld to beat.
On 79 minutes Ujpest sweeper Vilmos Sebok again put Kovacs clear on goal but he could only fire straight at the advancing Windfeld.
Aarhus' only serious attempt on goal came in the 54th minute, when Johnny Molby, cousin of former Danish international Jan Molby, had a pacey drive well-stopped by Ujpest keeper Laszlo Szucs.
